def simulate_snake(board_size, snake, food, moves):
    width, height = board_size
    snake = list(snake)
    food = list(food)
    
    # Direction vectors
    dir_vectors = {
        "UP": (0, -1),
        "DOWN": (0, 1),
        "LEFT": (-1, 0),
        "RIGHT": (1, 0)
    }
    
    # Opposite direction mapping
    opposites = {
        "UP": "DOWN",
        "DOWN": "UP",
        "LEFT": "RIGHT",
        "RIGHT": "LEFT"
    }
    
    alive = True
    food_eaten = 0
    
    for move in moves:
        if not alive:
            break
            
        # Determine current direction from head and second segment if available
        current_dir = None
        if len(snake) > 1:
            hx, hy = snake[0]
            nx, ny = snake[1]
            dx, dy = hx - nx, hy - ny
            for d_name, (dvx, dvy) in dir_vectors.items():
                if dvx == dx and dvy == dy:
                    current_dir = d_name
                    break
        
        # If requested move is opposite to current direction, keep current direction
        if current_dir and move == opposites[current_dir]:
            move = current_dir
            
        # Calculate new head position
        dvx, dvy = dir_vectors[move]
        new_head = (snake[0][0] + dvx, snake[0][1] + dvy)
        
        # Check wall collision
        nx, ny = new_head
        if not (0 <= nx < width and 0 <= ny < height):
            alive = False
            break
            
        # Check self collision
        # The tail cell is allowed to move into (unless we are not removing the tail, 
        # but the prompt says: "ちょうど移動しようとしている尻尾のマスを除く" -> 
        # the tail cell itself is exempt from self-collision).
        body_to_check = snake[:-1] if (food and new_head != food[0]) else snake
        if new_head in body_to_check:
            alive = False
            break
            
        # Check food collision
        grew = False
        if food and new_head == food[0]:
            food_eaten += 1
            food.pop(0)
            grew = True
            
        # Update snake body
        snake.insert(0, new_head)
        if not grew:
            snake.pop()
            
    return (snake, alive, food_eaten)
